vo_open.text: To drive to this American town, you have to go through Canada.

vo.text: Point Roberts, Washington. A small tip of land, hanging below Canada.
vo.cap: *Point Roberts:* a tip of land below *Canada.*

vo.text: In 1846, the border was set at the 49th parallel. And it cut this tip off.
To reach the rest of the US by road: forty kilometers through Canada. Two border crossings.
Older school kids cross the border four times a day.
vo.cap: School kids cross the border *4 times* a day.

vo.text: Should Point Roberts just join Canada? Yes or no? Comment below, and subscribe.
